title: Researchers and Students in Türkiye Build AI, Robotics Tools to Boost Disaster Readiness
description: Since a 7.8-magnitude earthquake hit Syria and Türkiye two years ago — leaving 55,000 people dead, 130,000 injured and millions displaced from their homes — students, researchers and developers have been harnessing the latest AI robotics technologies to increase disaster preparedness in the region.
